issue: जनक जननि पद कमल रज — the book prints पदम दुरज (not a word, the quarter short of 13 mātrās); its own version's other copies have पद्मराज (Chalisa Mala) and पद-रज (Shubh Panchang), both also short. The text takes Drik Panchang's पद कमल रज, the only witnessed form whole in sense and metre; the book's version may have read पदम-रज or पद्म-रज.
our reading: जनक जननि पद कमल रज: the dust of the lotus feet of father and mother.
alternatives: पदम रज / पद्मरज (the book's version, with the stray दु removed); पद-रज (Shubh Panchang).

issue: दुर्ग आदि हरनी — दुर्ग is 'difficulty, a hard place' (MW durga n.), but MW also gives Durga as the Asura slain by the Goddess (SkandaP.), which would fit the Durgā of cau28.
our reading: Mother, you are the remover of hardships (durga) and the like; show grace whenever they come.
alternatives: Slayer of the demon Durga and the others.
